title: Uniformity from constant point masses
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a finite type, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha$, and let $S\subseteq\alpha$ be a nonempty finite set. Suppose $p(a)=0$ for every $a\notin S$, and $p$ takes the same value at every pair of elements of $S$. Then $p$ is the uniform probability mass function on $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\alpha$
$S$ is a nonempty finite subset of $\alpha$
